newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq shares in lull before FOMC meeting.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq shares in lull before FOMC meeting.

text.p: Nasdaq share slipped slightly in quiet trading ahead of the Federal Reserve's interest rate policy meeting beginning Tuesday.
While most on Wall street expect interest rates to remain unchanged, investors adopted a wait-and-see stance.
"Nobody expects them to do anything, but everyone will lay low till they know for sure," said Nelson Gold, senior vice president of over-the-counter trading at Interstate-Johnson Lane Corp.

The Nasdaq Composite Index dropped 3.80 points or 0.28 percent to close unofficially at 1376.05. The Dow industrial slipped seven points to an unofficial close of 6806. The long bond gained 19/32 to yield 6.74 percent in late trading.
Stocks recovered from opening losses after the National Association of Purchasing Managers reported a January index a slightly below expectations.

U.S. Robotics Corp shares weakened 2-15/16 to 65-9/16 amid news that Rockwell International Corp will begin production of new high speed modem chips later this month. Computer networking company 3Com Corp also fell 5-1/8 to 62. Overall, Nasdaq losers beat gainers 2172 to 2114 on volume of 548 million shares.
